These match exactly the agent image (environment/Dockerfile L9-12) and solution/app/package.json dependencies (better-sqlite3 12.4.1, express 5.1.0), and the brief forbids other packages (instruction.md:15 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; integration.md L3-4 'use only those packages and Node built-ins'), so a conforming app needs nothing the verifier lacks. Runtime (PARTIAL): image hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair (id e32becea..., built 2026-10-01) has layer history matching every current Dockerfile RUN line; raw-evidence-index entries (hashes verified) show solve.sh installing the frozen golden there and workspace.cjs launching node /app/server.js as uid 65534 with NODE_PATH, a real restart, and Chromium via /usr/local/lib/node_modules/@playwright/mcp/node_modules/playwright with executablePath /usr/local/bin/chromium (workspace.cjs:6,299); via-solve.log all PASS. That confirms browser, bundled Playwright, Node, express and better-sqlite3 work in the verifier image. These are template-controlled and unchanged, so not a task defect, but per policy missing runtime evidence keeps risk=true.
